# Introduction

Social media has changed how students learn and communicate. Research shows that the the effect is large (Smith, 2020). this is a important point , and its been studied by Jones et al (2019).

i think teachers should of noticed this sooner,because the data is more clear than before!! Its a common pattern. See https://example.com/report for details.

Students who use social media for study groups report better outcomes than those who do not, especially when the groups are small, focused on a single course, guided by a clear schedule and supported by an instructor who checks in regularly.

## Conclusion

The evidence suggests careful use helps. More research is needed (Brown, 2018).
